about: Geometry of the code-drawn 65x67 small portrait card. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-31 after a review beside vanilla cards. Positions are in pixels of the 65x67 image; the card is drawn at 'scale' times the size and scaled down.

face.about: Where the face goes inside the card's photo window, as fractions of the window, for Measure-PortraitFaces.py crop. The window is the card box minus photoInset on every side.
